records.title: Benchmark of constitutive models for unsaturated soils
records.access: author_institution_repository_abstract; full text unavailable at this repository
records.established: Seven teams compared unsaturated-soil models using a supplied experimental programme and an undisclosed response test.
records.implication: Model benchmarking and genuinely undisclosed tests are precedents; the atlas development split must not be called blind.
unresolved: Full calibration freedom, initialization and scoring procedures require full-text review.

records.title: On the automatic parameter calibration of a hypoplastic soil model
records.established: The study compares optimizers and discrepancy measures for hypoplastic calibration on two sands and examines parameter dispersion over 500 calibrations.
records.implication: Optimizer comparisons and repeated-start parameter scatter are established topics. A calibration seed is not an experimental replicate.
unresolved: Review the detailed repeated-run protocol before quantitative comparison with our search diagnostics.

records.title: Automatic Parameter Calibration of Two Advanced Constitutive Models
records.established: Hypoplasticity and SANISAND are calibrated to Karlsruhe Sand compression and drained triaxial data. The objective uses curve distance and scaling involving both measured and simulated maxima.
records.implication: Multi-model automatic calibration is precedent. State our distinct fixed physical scaling explicitly. Karlsruhe Sand here must not automatically be equated with Karlsruhe fine sand.
unresolved: Exact parameter variants, source data access and information supplied need detailed mapping before reproduction.

records.title: Data strategies for automatic calibration of soil constitutive models
locators: Section 4.1, p. 9; full-dataset metric discussion, p. 11
records.established: Dataset subsets calibrate ten SANISAND-F constants with critical-state constants fixed. Preparation-dependent initial fabric is prescribed. The full-dataset score includes fitted tests.
records.implication: Separate unseen-test errors from mixed calibration/evaluation aggregates and account for fixed information and assumed initial states.
unresolved: Independent review and numerical reproduction remain open; no universal minimum-test claim transfers to our panel.
records.review_limits: Targeted source reading, not independent scientific review. Source figures are not added to benchmark evaluation or used to tune fits.

records.title: Inspection of three sophisticated constitutive models based on monotonic and cyclic tests on fine sand: Hypoplasticity vs. Sanisand vs. ISA
records.access: author_hosted_full_text_pdf; targeted methods and Table 1 review
locators: Table 1, author PDF p. 3; visually checked
records.established: Hypoplasticity with IGS, SANISAND 2004 and ISA 2014 share a fine-sand panel. Calibration uses index, compression, shear and cyclic evidence. Initial IGS mobilization depends on consolidation history.
records.implication: Count supplied measurements and history assumptions as information. The backbone constants in our pilot also match this Table 1; this does not reproduce the IGS simulations.
unresolved: Independent review and a full protocol comparison remain open.
records.review_limits: Targeted source reading, not independent scientific review. Source figures are not added to benchmark evaluation or used to tune fits.
